messages.content: Please check the weather in Tokyo and see if there are any weather alerts. If there are, save the weather alert card as a high-priority archive titled Tokyo trip weather archive for my Tokyo trip under user_id traveler_001. Then book flight AA100 for Jordan Lee in economy, look up the details for Hilton Tokyo, and prepare a deluxe room booking request for Jordan Lee from 2026-02-10 to 2026-02-14. Also, check for .pdf files in /projects/report, then back up the /projects workspace as trip_planning_backup and make that a high-priority app alert. Finally, send alice a high-priority app message saying: “Flight and hotel planning are ready, documents checked, and workspace backup completed.”
